fix(transport): loopback-bind test engines

The CI red on e6953ba was two findings. The typecheck one: the servers
array in wsTestSupport was typed Array<{stop}> while
drainClientsAndServers takes HalServer[]; retyped as Array<HalServer>.
The test one: the suites' engines called listen(0) on every interface,
and macOS lets that wildcard bind succeed where a specific-address
listener already holds the port, so a client dial to 127.0.0.1 is
delivered to the foreign listener and the test times out (reproduced
three ways in sessionResume.test.ts: two 404s from ports held by the
pod's own long-lived processes, one socket hang up). HalServer.start
gains an optional host, every suite binds 127.0.0.1, which the kernel
never hands out from under a specific listener; the acceptance harness
takes the same one-line bind with its assertions untouched.

Also pins the §4.3 off-lock statement at unit level in
messageHandler.test.ts and cites it on the spec statement; the comment
inserts shifted 35 test anchors, repointed by spec:names --fix. dod.md
ticks the repairs and records the §5.9 error-path unit coverage still
owed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
Refs re-cinq/HALEngine#144
